title: Vesta
tagline: Vesta utilizes a portion of CCA commitments for launch LP liquidity, by rewarding invested bidders.
description: Vesta is a token launch strategy for CCAs. The auction discovers the launch price, then bidders can opt to escrow ETH plus a percentage of their allocation for for locked liquidity position using vesta. The team strengthens launch liquidity, and in return, bidders get rewards set by the team.
how_its_made: The contracts are built with Solidity and tested with foundry, locally and on Sepolia testnet. uniswap v4 and CCA repos are used to implement the vesta strategy and vault contracts, the frontend allows a launch team to manage any of their CCA launches directly from the site, and any participants to manage their CCA bids and their vesta commitments. The frontend uses React for the UI, wagmi and ethers for wallet connections and onchain calls/reads.
auto_summary: A Solidity and React project that coordinates CCA auction commitments and migrates participant liquidity into Uniswap v4 positions.
